figs.name: cems-extractive-system-components-diagram
figs.alt: CEMS components diagram with heated probe, heated line, chiller, gas analyzers, flow monitor and DAHS
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing an extractive CEMS: heated probe and 180 °C line, 4 °C chiller, gas analyzers, stack flow monitor and DAHS reporting to the regulator.
figs.after_h2: CEMS Components: What Each Part Does

figs.name: cems-zero-span-calibration-flowchart
figs.alt: CEMS calibration flowchart for zero check, span check, correction factor and data substitution
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing CEMS calibration: zero within 2.5% of full scale, span within 5% of certified value, else the DAHS flags data and substitutes.
figs.after_h2: CEMS Calibration: Zero, Span and Linearity Checks
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>CEMS zero and span calibration check flowchart with data substitution</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">CEMS Zero and Span Check Logic</text>
<rect x="60" y="60" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="84.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero check</text>
<text x="210.0" y="107.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">inject nitrogen or zero air</text>
<line x1="210" y1="120" x2="210" y2="138" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="210,140.0 360.0,190 210,240.0 60.0,190" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="185.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Within 2.5%</text>
<text x="210" y="206.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">of full scale?</text>
<line x1="210" y1="240" x2="210" y2="268" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="230" y="260" font-size="17" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="60" y="270" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="294.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Span check</text>
<text x="210.0" y="317.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gas at 50 to 80% of span</text>
<line x1="210" y1="330" x2="210" y2="348" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="210,350.0 360.0,400 210,450.0 60.0,400" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="395.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Within 5% of</text>
<text x="210" y="416.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">certified value?</text>
<line x1="210" y1="450" x2="210" y2="488" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="230" y="475" font-size="17" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="60" y="490" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="519.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DAHS applies the</text>
<text x="210.0" y="542.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">correction factor (CCF)</text>
<polyline points="360,190 615,190 615,228" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="180" font-size="17" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<polyline points="360,400 615,400 615,372" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="390" font-size="17" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="450" y="230" width="330" height="140" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="259.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Check failed</text>
<text x="615.0" y="282.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DAHS flags the period and</text>
<text x="615.0" y="305.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">substitutes 90th percentile</text>
<text x="615.0" y="328.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">of last 720 operating hours</text>
<text x="615.0" y="351.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">then recalibrate</text>
<rect x="450" y="460" width="330" height="100" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="492.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Quarterly linearity</text>
<text x="615.0" y="515.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gases at 20, 50 and 80%</text>
<text x="615.0" y="538.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">each within 5%</text>
</svg>

figs.name: cems-extractive-vs-in-situ-infographic
figs.alt: extractive vs in situ CEMS comparison of basis, sample line, best use and maintenance
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing extractive and in situ CEMS by where gas is measured, dry or wet basis, sample line, best pollutants, maintenance and weak points.
figs.after_h2: Extractive CEMS vs In Situ CEMS
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 530" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Extractive CEMS vs in situ CEMS comparison infographic</title>
<rect width="800" height="530" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Extractive CEMS vs In Situ CEMS</text>
<rect x="240" y="60" width="265" height="60" rx="10" fill="#a16207" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="372.5" y="97.0" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Extractive</text>
<rect x="520" y="60" width="265" height="60" rx="10" fill="#0369a1" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="652.5" y="97.0" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">In situ</text>
<rect x="15" y="135" width="770" height="50" rx="8" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="167" font-size="18" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Measured at</text>
<text x="372" y="167" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">analyzer shelter</text>
<text x="652" y="167" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">on the stack</text>
<rect x="15" y="193" width="770" height="50" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="225" font-size="18" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Basis</text>
<text x="372" y="225" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">dry, convert to wet</text>
<text x="652" y="225" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">wet, directly</text>
<rect x="15" y="251" width="770" height="50" rx="8" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="283" font-size="18" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Sample line</text>
<text x="372" y="283" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">heated line, conditioner</text>
<text x="652" y="283" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">none</text>
<rect x="15" y="309" width="770" height="50" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="341" font-size="18" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Best for</text>
<text x="372" y="341" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">SO2, NOx, CO, multi gas</text>
<text x="652" y="341" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sticky HF and HCl</text>
<rect x="15" y="367" width="770" height="50" rx="8" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="399" font-size="18" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Maintenance</text>
<text x="372" y="399" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">easy, in shelter</text>
<text x="652" y="399" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">hard without shutdown</text>
<rect x="15" y="425" width="770" height="50" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="457" font-size="18" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Weak point</text>
<text x="372" y="457" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">more failure points</text>
<text x="652" y="457" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">harsh stack conditions</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Opacity (particulate) is always monitored in situ across the stack</text>
</svg>
